run_simulated_hand_with_vr_glove: run the pybullet simulated robot hand controlled by a VR glove via serial communication
create_serial_connection: create a serial connection to a VR glove sensor using getSerialOrNone with configurable port
convert_sensor_reading: convert a raw VR glove sensor reading to a normalized 0-1 value using convertSensor
load_mjcf_hand_model: load a MuJoCo MJCF hand model into pybullet using p.loadMJCF for simulation
control_hand_joints: control simulated hand joint positions using p.setJointMotorControl2 with POSITION_CONTROL
